title: lycium chinense var. cochinchinense
intro: Lycium chinense var. cochinchinense, commonly known as the Chinese boxthorn or goji berry, is a deciduous shrub native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting properties, which may help protect against age-related diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as polysaccharides, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which may exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective effects. Additionally, the goji berry has been traditionally used to support eye health, reduce fatigue, and improve cognitive function.
